messages:
Ria Patel: Quick heads-up — drafting the internal RN for tomorrow's release. Need a fast pin + deploybot cue when ops gives the green light. Draft snippet below, please skim and flag anything that needs to be toned down for customers.

Ria Patel: Draft: "Rolling release: optimizations to batching and KV cache fallback (no API surface changes). Small risk: transient 5xx during first 15m of canary while caches warm. See rollback lanes."

Sam Chen: LGTM on wording, call out exact change window (UTC) so SRE/CS can plan. Also add which model versions are pinned.

Ria Patel: Good call — adding: "Change window: 2026-03-22 02:00–04:00 UTC. Pinned model: rdl-model-v1.3.2 (canary), fallback: rdl-model-v1.2.9."

devops-bot: /deploy start release-2026-03-22-canary --pin rdl-model-v1.3.2 --canary 5%

devops-bot: Deploy queued by @Ria Patel. Estimated runtime: 8m. Notify channel when canary finishes.

Lina Gomez: Confirming ops checklist: health checks enabled, alert thresholds 3xx/5xx > 1% -> auto-rollback, latency p95 +250ms -> alert. Also need to attach the canary dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/rdl/canary-release-2026-03-22

Marcus Li: For rollback lanes: prefer automated rollback to v1.2.9 unless we see persistent user-visible errors, in which case manual rollback and incident owner triage. Adding runbook pointer.

ops-oncall: @Ria Patel please add runbook link and escalation path in the RN: https://wiki.redwood/release-runbooks/rdl-canary-2026-03-22. I'll be on-call during window.

Ria Patel: Done — RN updated with runbook + pager chain. Also added: oncall contact @ops-oncall, SRE lead @Marcus Li.

Sam Chen: Small nit: change "transient 5xx" to "short-lived 5xx spikes" and add estimated monitoring hold: first 30m watch.

Ria Patel: Updated. Also prepped the one-liner for the staff blast: "Deploying batching + cache improvements — minimal risk; watching canary 5% for 30m; rollback auto-enabled."

Lina Gomez: Can we pin a specific person to post the internal blast? I can do it but need the final approved one-liner and RN link.

Ria Patel: If ops signs off, @Lina Gomez can post. Final one-liner + links at T-10m.

Marcus Li: Ops sign-off: ✅ health checks & alerts set, dashboard linked, rollback auto-policy configured.

ops-oncall: On-call ack ✅. I'll watch the channel and escalate if thresholds hit.

devops-bot: Deploy started: release-2026-03-22-canary (5%). Logs: ```
[00:00] Scheduling canary on pool-a
[00:02] Model rdl-model-v1.3.2 loaded on nodes 3/3
[00:05] Traffic shift to 5%
```

Ria Patel: Thanks all. Lina, ping when you post the internal blast and I'll pin the RN to the announcement. :thumbsup:

Lina Gomez: Will do. Posting at T+12m after initial validation window.

Sam Chen: Add note for release notes: follow-up doc with perf deltas attached after full rollout.

Ria Patel: Yep — I'll attach perf artifacts in the post-rollout RN update.

(End of thread)
